summary.going_well: The agent disclosed its AI role <ref job="SRJ_srxRDnsQ5N59" item="item_fa6c1003-29f">at opening</ref>, explained the <ref job="SRJ_RSwKmKES2jD2" item="item_2afeff87-ce5">HELOC’s collateral, variable-rate, and repayment risks</ref>, and consistently left the <ref job="SRJ_3S2RBHKrAhxu" item="item_1cff5a7f-213">soft-review-versus-summary choice</ref> to the borrower. summary.to_improve: First, qualify conventional-refinance claims so general education cannot be mistaken for a borrower-specific promise. Stop requesting employer names unnecessarily and explicitly respect refusals; replace recurring judgments about debt and credit with neutral acknowledgments.

issues.description: In two refinance conversations, the agent described conventional refinancing as having “no upfront government fees, no permanent mortgage insurance once you reach 20% equity, and higher loan limits” <ref job="SRJ_3S2RBHKrAhxu" item="item_b9941434-79c">without qualifying which features apply</ref>; it repeated the claims in <ref job="SRJ_srxRDnsQ5N59" item="item_485d4f6d-e00">another refinance conversation</ref>. This risks misleading borrowers about their specific loan options.
issues.suggestion: Make product comparisons conditional, distinguish general program features from borrower-specific outcomes, and defer applicable fees, insurance, and limits to the eligibility review or licensed loan officer.
issues.label: Product claims

issues.description: Across the four refinance and equity conversations, the agent <ref job="SRJ_kU7gLdoZhkor" item="item_e7b4b6e1-90a">requested an employer name</ref> but <ref job="SRJ_kU7gLdoZhkor" item="item_0a8a432f-00f">received an explicit refusal</ref> in one and <ref job="SRJ_srxRDnsQ5N59" item="item_d6ab9f67-ec6">another</ref>; it <ref job="SRJ_srxRDnsQ5N59" item="item_3c877b14-de3">advanced without acknowledging the boundary</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Ask for employer identity only if required at this stage; otherwise request tenure and pay type, and acknowledge a refusal without implying the name was captured.
issues.label: Intake friction

issues.description: The agent repeatedly assessed borrowers’ finances rather than acknowledging them neutrally, calling debt <ref job="SRJ_kU7gLdoZhkor" item="item_98f9adb0-f80">“very manageable”</ref> and a credit score <ref job="SRJ_srxRDnsQ5N59" item="item_d5aabe15-94d">“great”</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Replace financial-profile evaluations with neutral acknowledgments; reserve assessments for the eligibility review or loan officer.
